subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

QPON ∶ RRRR ∶∶ IJGK ∶ JLJO ∶∶ PKON ∶ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is :

 
• First letter ⇒ (1) is added to the position value according English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter ⇒ (2) is added to the position value according English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter ⇒ (3) is added to the position value according English alphabetic series.
 
• Fourth letter ⇒ (4) is added to the position value according English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• QPON ∶ RRRR

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fac36158b63939f7671caa7d1387825151d78f45d93318ccf1ec27ea2e9de693.png] 

And,

 
• IJGK ∶ JLJO

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb7919c59cd33c91e3d003c73943351f717d398d30c760825f77db25fb620411.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• PKON ∶ ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59cd79073c79002d6730c23b0ae3dc96d6bc0eee620f896f404966b7998eafae.png] 

​Hence, "**QMRR**" is the correct answer.
